scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: Camping weekend! Follow the path up the hill — our camp is next to the waterfall.
scene.intro: Camping weekend! Follow the path up the hill — the camp is next to the wood, near the waterfall you can hear from far away. There is a small island in the middle of the lake and there is a cave behind the rocks that Ingrid wants to explore immediately. There are no shops, no cars and no wifi, only stars and the sound of water. Oliver says it is the best night of the year. What is there in the countryside near YOUR home?

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the nature words.

words.clue: Water that falls from high rocks. It is very loud!
Land with water all around it.
A dark hole in a mountain. Bats live here.
A small way to walk in the countryside.
You sleep inside it when you go camping.

activities.title: Match the place with what you can do there.
Listen to the camping story. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (capitana de campamento) y Oliver (con la guitarra).
data.script: Ingrid: We walked up the path for two hours to reach the camp. … Oliver: My legs hurt! But the view from the hill was fantastic. … Ingrid: We put our tents next to the waterfall. … Oliver: The water was so loud that I sang louder than ever! … Ingrid: In the evening we made a fire and cooked soup. … Oliver: Then we explored the cave behind the waterfall — we saw six little bats! … Ingrid: At night the sky was full of stars. We counted more than a hundred. … Oliver: Best camping trip ever. Next time, Kili comes too!
